mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increase and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real GDP signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 decline and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals labor market weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the negative economic signal.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increase and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production signals a strengthening supply environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increase and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as increased construction activity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST increase and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals labor market strength, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors react to the positive economic signal.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decrease and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 5% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth slows by more than 1% and the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.3% within the last 3 months, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines > 1% and UNRATE increases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of GDPC1 decline and UNRATE increase on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
